author: Russell Brand
description:
It's been a full year since the Epstein Files Transparency Act was signed into law, promising real investigation and prosecution of the men connected to Epstein, and Russell can't help but riff on exactly who got named publicly and who conveniently didn't. He jokes his way through a genuinely dark pattern too, pointing out how often people holding damaging information seem to turn up dead by apparent suicide, and lists off the classic buzzwords worth watching for whenever that happens. Russell at his sharpest and funniest, using comedy to point directly at something that still hasn't been resolved a full year later.

title: Why are there still no arrests?!

author: Russell Brand
description:
In this episode of Sunday Service with the Brands, we reflect on praying love over our enemies and the darkness that can appear as the show reaches more people. We share a listener’s voice message and answer his question directly. We also explore a controversial cutting of local trees, the love and loss of natural surroundings, but the enduring hope found in Job 14:7.
